description: Generic read-only call to any contract on Base: provide an address and hex calldata (4-byte selector, e.g. 0x18160ddd = totalSupply, optionally followed by ABI-encoded args) and get the raw return data plus best-effort uint/address/bool/string decoding. Read-only (never sends a transaction). Use this for arbitrary view functions not covered by a dedicated tool. Price: 0.0030 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

data.description: Hex calldata starting with a 4-byte function selector (e.g. "0x18160ddd")

name: contract-read
title: Contract Read
